'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
